subject: Kickoff: label-bias correction as a pipeline pre-processing stage
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off the label-bias track for trust-theory. The premise from our open-source release: datasets carry biases because labelers — modeled as an agent intending accuracy but biased against certain groups — overwrite the unknown, unbiased labels. The method's punchline is that you can correct this by re-weighting data points without changing any labels, with theoretical guarantees that training on the re-weighted set corresponds to training on the unbiased labels.

Productization goal: a drop-in pre-processing stage any Meridian pipeline can enable, plus a report artifact for model cards.

Milestones (Mar 2 - Jul 6):
- Apr 10: reproduce the paper's results on the standard fairness benchmarks across the supported fairness notions
- May 22: pipeline-stage API in review; two internal teams identified for pilots
- Late June: full re-weighting sweep across our model families, then a decision memo for the LRB

Deshawn — resourcing please, including the June sweep compute which is the big-ticket item.

Ximena
